description_en: Queries the details about the cloud migration task of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS PostgreSQL迁移上云任务详情
name: DescribeCloudMigrationResult

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances接口查询
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can obtain the task ID from the response that is returned when you call the CreateCloudMigrationTask operation to create the task
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。调用CreateCloudMigrationTask接口创建RDS PostgreSQL迁移上云任务时响应消息中获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task name. You can obtain the task name from the response that is returned when you call the CreateCloudMigrationTask operation to create the task
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。调用CreateCloudMigrationTask接口创建RDS PostgreSQL迁移上云任务时响应消息中获取
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The private IP address that is used to connect to the self-managed PostgreSQL instance.

If the self-managed PostgreSQL instance resides on an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance, enter the private IP address of the ECS instance. For more information about how to obtain the private IP address of an ECS instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273914.html.
If the self-managed PostgreSQL instance resides in a data center, enter the private IP address of the data center
parameters.help_zh:
自建PostgreSQL数据库的内网IP。

ECS自建PostgreSQL数据库一键上云场景，配置ECS实例的私网IP。获取方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273914.html。
IDC自建PostgreSQL数据库一键上云场景，配置为IDC的内网IP
parameters.name: source_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The port number that is used to connect to the self-managed PostgreSQL instance. You can run the netstat -a | grep PGSQL command to obtain the port number
parameters.help_zh: 自建PostgreSQL数据库的端口。可通过netstat -a | grep PGSQL命令查看
parameters.name: source_port

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_number
